description: 3-phase multimeter with Modbus RTU: instantaneous values, min/max/demand with timestamps, network and alarm setup, relays and identification (float32 values, big-endian assumed).

sources.title: EMMXX Register table
sources.note: manufacturer's register table for EMM-04S and EMM-04CS

notes: Currents are in mA, not A.
Relays, digital inputs and outputs, pulse and alarm registers need the I/O model (EMM-04CS); the table marks which registers each model has.
The alarm dynamic block (20500-20531), the alarm slot registers 17202 to 17328 (first register of each alarm) and the enumerated codes are not mapped. See the table.
The table does not state byte or word order. Not tested on a device.
